reviews.name: Trina Knight
reviews.text: Seattle Locksmith Service provided excellent service from start to finish. They responded quickly, arrived on time, and were very professional throughout the entire process. The technician carefully assessed the situation and fixed my lock efficiently without any damage or delays. Their pricing was fair and transparent, with no hidden charges.

reviews.name: Jayram RK
reviews.text: I had an emergency with my car lock and Seattle Locksmith saved the day. They arrived fast, unlocked my car without any scratches and were very polite and professional throughout the process. The price was fair and the service was top-notch. I highly recommend them for any car locksmith needs.

reviews.name: Lim Kooi Hock
reviews.text: The technician arrived on time, was extremely professional, and handled the situation calmly and efficiently. He explained what he was doing and made sure not to damage the lock or door. It's hard to find a locksmith you can truly trust but Seattle Locksmith Service exceeded my expectations.

reviews.name: Tonya Smith
reviews.text: Gary provided fast, friendly, honest, and professional service during my recent lockout experience. He called me back almost immediately and arrived at my house in ten minutes ready to work. He resolved the issue well, and was very courteous and helpful. I would use this service again.

reviews.name: JC
reviews.text: He came over and did 12 locks in an hour. Amazing. Had old 30 year door locks in dull brown, rekeyed everything into brushed nickel. The job ended up bigger than he thought. He got it done in record time. Great effort.

reviews.name: Katherine Thompson
reviews.text: Seattle Locksmith Service did an amazing job. Quick response time, very professional and they handled my lock issue efficiently. Fair pricing and excellent customer service, highly recommended!

reviews.name: Brenda Arriens
reviews.text: Gary was there when promised and had everything to do the job we called in about AND when we asked about additional work, he did it on the spot. Explained everything very well and was very quick.

reviews.name: Patricia King
reviews.text: Cam was here on time and did very nice work. He came back and installed the deadbolt in my back door. I would highly recommend him.

reviews.name: Amber Scarpitti
reviews.text: Very fast response and did a great job. Even walked through how the new remote worked and was patient. Thank you!

reviews.name: lee sakolsky
reviews.text: He was very good. Fixed my key fob problem fast.

reviews.name: Dianne Shaw
reviews.text: Great service! Within 30 min of calling I was in my car again!

reviews.name: Jordan Andrews
reviews.text: Got locked out of a newer apartment and he was here so quick! So nice and professional!

reviews.name: Rebekah Lea Phelps
reviews.text: I really appreciate dealing with this company. They honored the price they gave me over the phone, have great follow up, and gave me a cheaper option for the locks on my desk.

reviews.name: Mossy Oak Way
reviews.text: Concise, meticulous and reliable service, delivered on time at competitive prices. This locksmith service went far and beyond our expectations. I highly recommend them to anyone who needs key services for their home or auto.

reviews.name: Harold Powell
reviews.text: A place that will care about you and take care of all your security solutions when needed. Amazing staff and technicians.

reviews.name: Kelly K Johnson
reviews.text: Very efficient and friendly work to open my bedroom lock which was not responding. Drake was exceptional.

reviews.name: Joe White
reviews.text: Great price, fast and legit service, and guaranteed. I would recommend them to anyone who needs that type of service.

reviews.name: C Norton
reviews.text: Fast service, very professional and friendly. I was very pleased with the completed outcome. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Isaac Markus
reviews.text: Amazing service. Would totally recommend this company. They were extremely fast and professional.

reviews.name: Camila Cappella
reviews.text: I was happy to see that the job was done just as we agreed. The service was good, and I appreciated the way the business handled everything.
